verdict.rationale: GitBook docs confirm branding-oriented customization (custom domain, 'Advanced branding options', a 'Site customization' page, and a block-based editor with custom blocks), which supports some brand-matching needs, but none of the evidence describes custom CSS/JS injection or building fully custom components — core parts of the story. A dated community review even calls out that 'landing page customization limited' in the classic product. missing for 10: explicit support for custom CSS/JS overrides, custom component/theme injection, and independent confirmation these deep customizations work as advertised.
